non_claims: does not prove credential rotation against a live broker
does not prove restricted-principal authorization or published security profiles
does not claim support for mechanisms absent from this contract

entries.validation: uses raw TCP with no SASL credentials; configured protocol is retained on failure
entries.failure: transport or protocol error is returned without a security downgrade
entries.rotation: credential rotation is not applicable; replace the connection to change transport configuration
entries.redaction: credential redaction is not applicable; diagnostics still avoid payload secrets

entries.validation: server name, root certificate, and optional client certificate/private-key pairing are checked before connect
entries.failure: TLS validation or handshake failure poisons the connection and never falls back to plaintext
entries.rotation: trust roots and client certificate/key changes apply on a replacement connection
entries.redaction: private-key and certificate bytes are redacted from Debug output

entries.validation: username/password credentials are required for the configured SASL protocol
entries.failure: handshake or authenticate failure returns a typed error and poisons the authenticated connection
entries.rotation: password changes require a new authenticated connection
entries.redaction: password is replaced with <redacted> in credentials, config, and errors

entries.validation: SCRAM username/password and server-final signature are checked during the bounded exchange
entries.failure: nonce, proof, signature, handshake, or broker errors poison the connection without plaintext fallback
entries.rotation: password changes require a replacement connection and a fresh SCRAM exchange
entries.redaction: password and SCRAM material are redacted from Debug and error text

entries.validation: SCRAM-SHA-512 username/password and server-final signature are checked during the bounded exchange
entries.failure: nonce, proof, signature, handshake, or broker errors poison the connection without plaintext fallback
entries.rotation: password changes require a replacement connection and a fresh SCRAM exchange
entries.redaction: password and SCRAM material are redacted from Debug and error text

entries.validation: token expiry, provider timeout, and optional authorization identity are checked before SASL authenticate
entries.failure: provider, challenge, expiry, or broker errors poison the connection and preserve the configured SASL protocol
entries.rotation: cached provider refreshes inside its window; re-authentication or connection replacement uses the new token
entries.redaction: bearer token and provider material are replaced with <redacted> in Debug and errors

entries.validation: certificate chain and private key must be supplied together and are rejected for plaintext/SASL_PLAINTEXT
entries.failure: invalid DER or handshake failure returns a typed TLS error without changing the configured protocol
entries.rotation: certificate/key changes apply to replacement connections; existing authenticated sockets are not mutated
entries.redaction: certificate and private-key bytes are redacted from Debug output
